jobs.description:
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are. 1 Student Project/Program Purchasing (m/w/x) Job Responsibilities:

As a Working Student, you will have the opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience in an industrial environment while working up to 20 hours per week. In this role, you will support the Program Purchasing team and gain exciting insights into both strategic and operational procurement processes through your active involvement.

 * Analyze procurement markets and prepare relevant market intelligence and information

 * Support the development and implementation of commodity strategies

 * Assist with supplier management activities

 * Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of the supplier inquiry process

 * Support the preparation and participation in supplier negotiations and contract agreements

 * Help ensure budget targets are achieved in line with the business plan

Who we are looking for:

 * Confident and professional personality with the ability to build trust and maintain strong relationships with suppliers

 * Independent, structured, and excellent attention to detail

 * Strong willingness to learn and a high level of motivation

 * Team-oriented mindset with a proactive attitude and a willingness to contribute to shared success

Your preferred qualifications:

 * Currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economy, or related field (preferred over a purely technical background)

 * Specialization in Supply Chain Management or initial internship experience in the field is an advantage

 * Knowledge of SAP is desirable

 * Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken

What you can look forward to:

It is important to us to offer a fair and attractive remuneration package. The gross annual salary (for 38.5 hours) according to the collective agreement of the automotive industry is at least € 2.698,59 [14x p.a.] for this position. Overpayment based on relevant experience and qualifications is common practice.

In addition, we offer the following benefits:

 * Work-Life-Balance: flexible working hours, 24/12 and 31/12 are free of work and no vacation days have to be consumed for this purpose, remote work to the extent of up to 40% of working hours, various paternal leave models

 * Bonus and financial benefits: benefits via the works council (discounts, vouchers, subsidies)

 * Health: sports and team events, health checks, support from fitness trainers, physiotherapists, and work psychologists

 * Training and development: extensive training options, exciting internal development opportunities, attractive career paths (management career, specialist career)

 * Work environment: canteen / food vouchers, state-of-the-art IT and work equipment, parking for two-wheelers, four-wheelers or electric vehicles, open corporate culture

 * Work environment: canteen with freshly cooked meals, state-of-the-art IT and work equipment, parking for two-wheelers, four-wheelers or electric vehicles, open corporate culture

 About the role:

As a Senior Specialist Enterprise Solution Architect, you are responsible for designing and governing enterprise-level, cross-domain solution architectures within the MPT IT landscape.

You translate business capabilities and requirements into scalable, integrated, and sustainable solutions across enterprise applications, data, integration, infrastructure, and cloud platforms, with future readiness in mind.

Your responsibilities:

 * Driving the development and continuous enhancement of enterprise and solution architecture principles and standards in close collaboration with domain experts from business applications, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud, security, and OT

 * Conducting business and system analyses across multiple domains to identify opportunities for optimization, digitalization, integration, and modernization

 * Defining and aligning cross-domain target architectures and architectural roadmaps together with business and IT stakeholders

 * Evaluating architecture-relevant demands within the demand management process, assessing architectural impact and ensuring alignment with IT strategy, architecture principles, and integration requirements

 * Designing end-to-end enterprise solution architectures across business applications, enterprise platforms, integration, data, infrastructure, and cloud, including interfaces to OT/IoT environments where relevant

 * Ensuring solution architectures are aligned with enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, technology standards, and strategic platform decisions

 * Providing architectural guidance and governance throughout project implementation, supporting projects in translating approved solution architectures into implementation

 * Ensuring architectural transparency and quality by maintaining relevant architecture artifacts and architectural decisions in LeanIX

 * Coaching and enabling business, IT, and OT stakeholders in applying architecture principles, target architectures, and solution concepts

What we are looking for:

 * A degree in computer science, business informatics, or a comparable qualification

 * More than 10 years of relevant professional experience in an enterprise IT environment, ideally within the automotive or manufacturing industry

 * Experience in business and system analysis across complex application landscapes, including the assessment of dependencies, integration requirements, and architectural impacts

 * Strong understanding of enterprise application landscapes, application and integration architectures, APIs, data flows, and hybrid IT environments (on-premises and cloud); experience with manufacturing IT and OT/IoT integration is an advantage

 * Certifications in IT architecture or IT service management (e.g., ITIL) are an advantage

 * Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, along with the ability to present complex architectural topics in a structured and audience-appropriate manner

 * Ability and willingness to combine strategic, conceptual, and implementation-oriented responsibilities

 * Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 15%)

 * English language skills (C1) are required; German language skills are desirable

Benefits:
